title: leucanthemum rotundifolium
intro: Leucanthemum rotundifolium, commonly known as Round-leaved Oxeye Daisy, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its health benefits, such as promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum rotundifolium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive constituents and their exact therapeutic actions on the human body.
